_comment: The headline written across the top of each App Store screenshot, per locale.
Scripts/frame-screenshots.swift draws these over the raw captures; the keys are the
screenshot file names, so a shot added to ScreenshotTests needs a line here in every
locale or the framing step stops. A newline is a deliberate line break: the wrap is
part of the typography, and letting it fall where it likes reads as an accident.

en-US.01-groups:
Every trip, every flatshare,
in one place
en-US.02-expenses:
Add what you spent,
in seconds
en-US.03-split:
Split it the way
it actually happened
